Onboard a New Hire

User manual · English · 15 steps
Learn how to prepare a new hire's onboarding: set their manager and user account, launch the onboarding plan that creates their to-do list, and find their documents and equipment.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. Open the new hire

Click the new hire's card to open the record.

3. Open Manager

Click here to choose the manager.

4. Choose the manager

Click the result you want in the list.

5. HR Settings tab

Open the HR Settings tab.

6. Search Related User

Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

ℹ️ Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

7. Choose the user

Click the result you want in the list.

Click the save icon to keep the changes.

Click Launch Plan to start the onboarding.
